name: sandals
description: Luxury travel concierge for Sandals and Beaches Resorts: search resorts, check room availability and flexible dates, browse restaurant menus, and track prices with Discord alerts.

env.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: Discord webhook URL for price-drop notifications. Price-watch tools run but stay silent until this is set.

env.name: PORT
env.description: If set, serve over streamable-http on this port instead of stdio.

env.name: HOST
env.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.
